text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Finally cornered it!
Man, this time was a total mess...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっと追い詰めた！
ったく、
今回は散々だったぜ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: But once we get past this, a fun Christmas awaits!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもここを乗り越えたら、
楽しいクリスマスが待ってるよ！

text_block_list.name: Misora
text_block_list.text:
Yes yes★
And there's a bird right there that'd make a great main dish♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですです★
ちょうどそこに、
メイン料理に良さそうな鳥もいますし♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, turkey's for this season, huh...
Whether we eat this one or not aside,
partying with this crew might be fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういや七面鳥ってこの時期か……
こいつを食うかは別として、
このメンツでパーティーすんのはアリかもな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Let's push through just a bit more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね！
あと一息がんばろう！
